annotations.title: Documents checklist for an Israeli process

description: Returns the verified checklist of documents and steps for an Israeli bureaucratic process (unemployment claim, maternity allowance, passport, car ownership transfer, address change, after birth, after the army, arnona discount, tax refund, opening an osek patur, police certificate and the forms we cover), with official links and sources. | רשימת מסמכים ושלבים לתהליך. Stateless: arguments and results are never stored, logged or shared (nayeret.ai/developers/). Not legal or tax advice.

lang.description: Language of the summary text: he (default) or en. Files stay in Hebrew (official forms and Israeli letters).
